label: Business Owner Tax Planning
headline: Your business has grown. Your tax strategy should keep pace.
intro: Entity structure, owner compensation, retirement funding, and the next transaction deserve one coordinated plan. Explore the decisions behind a stronger tax position, then bring your priorities to AE Tax Advisors.
topics: Understand how legal ownership, tax elections, distributions, and your exit plans interact.
Connect the work you do with payroll, benefits, reimbursements, and distribution records.
Evaluate owner goals alongside employee coverage, funding commitments, and business cash flow.
Prepare the evidence behind business expenses before deciding how they should be reported.
Work through industry-specific records, decision files, and editable preparation worksheets.
Follow a planning question from source documents to an accountable handoff.
prepare: Three years of business and personal returns, with supporting schedules
Current profit-and-loss statements and a year-end forecast
Ownership, elections, payroll, distributions, and benefit-plan records
Planned purchases, hiring, distributions, or ownership changes
steps: Map operating businesses, ownership, household income, and the decisions ahead.
Compare the timing, limitations, cash requirements, and implementation responsibilities.
Confirm who will handle payroll, elections, filings, and ongoing review.
